summary: Mostly no: most CR settings did the same as random entries on BTC, ETH and SOL. The result that holds up is a fresh Strong Buy on 4h, which beat random entries by 1.37% after 20 candles, and still did without its strongest stretch and at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles. That gap came from downtrends and from SOL. In uptrends it was the same as random.

notes: A fresh Strong Buy on 4h gave 395 entries in 273 separate moves. Twenty candles later price was 1.37% ahead of random entries, against a band of -0.81 to 0.79. In downtrends the gap was 2.26% and it held. In uptrends it was 0.55%, inside the band, so the result belongs to downtrends. SOL beat random on its own at 2.67%, while BTC at 0.58% and ETH at 0.95% were the same as random.

On 1h the same fresh Strong Buy gave 1,852 entries against 395 on 4h, and there it was the same as random at 0.08%. Holding long on every 1h candle that reads Strong Buy beat random by 0.14%. It held without the stretch between Dec 25, 2020 and Jan 10, 2021, and at every horizon. That gap came from uptrends, at 0.13%. In downtrends it was 0.08%, the same as random. On 4h the same rule rests on SOL signals between Jul 29 and Sep 11, 2021, and without them it is the same as random.

Shorting a fresh Strong Sell on 1h did 0.25% better than random entries after 20 candles. It held without its strongest stretch and at 10 and 50 candles, but not at 100. Uptrends carried it at 0.27%. In downtrends it showed nothing, at 0.06%. On ETH alone it looked better only because of signals on Nov 7–8, 2022, during the FTX collapse. On 4h and daily, a fresh Strong Sell was the same as random.

The two featured every-candle rules mostly track random entries. On 1h, Buy or Strong Buy and Sell or Strong Sell both landed at 0.03%, inside their bands. On 4h the long side looked better only because of the run between Dec 25, 2020 and May 21, 2021. On daily the short side rests on the stretch between Nov 18, 2021 and Jan 2, 2023. In daily uptrends that short beat random by 5.61% and held without its strongest stretch, but only at 10 and 20 candles. Daily downtrends had too few moves to judge.

A fresh Buy was the same as random on 1h at -0.02% and on 4h at -0.19%. On daily it was 2.88% worse than random, against a band of -2.3 to 2.66. That shows at 20 candles only and is the same as random at 10, 50 and 100. Uptrends carried it at -5.93%. In downtrends it was 1.87%, the same as random.

For a long bot on 4h, a fresh Strong Buy is the one CR reading worth testing as a filter beside your other start conditions. Its gap came from downtrends and SOL, so check your pair before you rely on it in an uptrend. The 1h Strong Sell short is small at 0.25%, so weigh it against your take profit and DCA spacing rather than treating it as a trigger. Leave out Buy or Strong Buy on every candle: on 1h it added nothing over random entries.
